integrity: All integer identities have been checked using exact arithmetic; a full finite witness enumeration is embedded, while independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the odd exactly three-deficient-perfect class with three distinct prime factors and total prime-factor multiplicity six is classified. Other even exponent configurations, and other prime supports, remain unclassified here. Bibliographic search is not absolute priority certification.
title: The first three-prime-square layer of odd exactly \(3\)-deficient-perfect numbers
